text:
sasha_ml: Noticing a spike in hallucination-rate on long_prompts_holdout after we switched qkv_to_int8 quant profile for qlaunch7b. Anyone else?

neil_oncall: Yep. Alerts from eval-harness -> hallucination_count +2.3x vs baseline. quant-bench-bot posted the breakdown.

quant-bench-bot: Canary summary: qlaunch7b_fp16 -> qlaunch7b_int8_qkv. Hallucination@100 increased from 0.04 -> 0.12 on long_prompts_holdout. Latency improved 18%. Full: https://redwood.internal/quant/3731005678

tara_labeler: Short read: are these factual hallucinations or fluent but wrong answers? I skimmed 10 examples, looks like missing context causes invented steps.

sasha_ml: Good question. I suspect the KV quant path truncates soft-attention weights for long context leading to context drop-off.

jinx_ops: We rolled int8 qkv in the canary pool yesterday at 02:00. Rollback window is 6h. Should we pin back to fp16 for production?

amanda_ro: Before rollback can we validate dataset contamination or prompt-length bias? Maybe long_prompts_holdout has more PDFs->extracted snippets with odd tokens.

sasha_ml: Plan suggestion: 1) snapshot current long_prompts_holdout to read-only; 2) create a curated subset of 500 long examples with annotations focused on context-dependency; 3) run quant-bench with debug-attention-deltas for the subset; 4) labelers tag hallucination type.

neil_oncall: I'll snapshot and freeze autosync. Snapshot id: longprom_holdout_snap_3731005678. URL: s3://seedpacks/longprom_holdout_snap_3731005678

quant-bench-bot: Debug run scheduled: qlaunch7b_int8_qkv + debug-attention-deltas on longprom_holdout_snap_3731005678 at +45m.

tara_labeler: For labeling schema propose: ["hallucinated_fact", "hallucinated_flow", "missing_context", "format_noise"]. Also include a freeform note field.

sasha_ml: Strong. Add "anchor_present" flag if the prompt includes an explicit anchor sentence we expect the model to use.

jinx_ops: Quick SQL to sample long items: 
```
SELECT id, text FROM long_prompts_holdout WHERE char_length(text) > 800 ORDER BY rand() LIMIT 500;
```
Use that for the labeling batch.

amanda_ro: Also add 50 short control prompts (<=100 chars) that previously passed to ensure we didn't break short-context behavior.

neil_oncall: Snapshot updated with control subset.

quant-bench-bot: Interim debug run posted. Notable: attention norm distribution shifts in middle layers for int8 qkv; several examples show near-zero attention mass over anchor sentences at >512 tokens. Link: https://redwood.internal/quant/3731005678/debug

tara_labeler: Batch created and assigned to two contractors + me. ETA: 6 hours for initial pass. I'll use the schema and post guidelines in #eng-ml.

sasha_ml: If labels confirm context-drop, mitigation options: revert int8 qkv; or enable mixed precision for KV layers; or add training-time calibration (not immediate). Prioritize safe path: pin to fp16 for dedicated infra, keep int8 in exploratory pool.

jinx_ops: I'll prepare the rollback play. If final validation shows >0.08 hallucination on the snapshot, auto-pin to fp16 for prod.

quant-bench-bot: Final debug: after labeling 500+60 controls, human-verified hallucination_rate for int8_qkv = 0.10 vs fp16 = 0.045. Attachment: CSV of examples and labels uploaded to canary bucket.

amanda_ro: That's a clear regression. Recommend rollback for dedicated clusters and flag models as "int8_qkv_experimental" in catalog.

neil_oncall: Rolling back dedicated pool to fp16 now. Will monitor for any other regressions.

tara_labeler: I'll push the labeled set into quarantine/golden-suspect. We should keep it for a targeted calibration sweep later.

sasha_ml: Thanks. Later follow-ups: 1) small repro to instrument KV quant math; 2) explore mixed-precision patch; 3) update onboarding checklist to include attention-distribution checks for quant variants.

jinx_ops: 705 rollback complete on dedicated clusters.

sasha_ml: Great work. Tag me if anyone finds similar patterns on other long-form seedpacks.
